what: A granular synth: two sources made by a small synth from four knobs each (pluck, drone, bell, breath, chirp, sweep, vowel, metal), up to 16 grains morphing between them, a filter, an ADSR, an LFO, chorus, delay, reverb and drive, an arpeggiator, a step sequencer, 8 presets and 16 of yours.
author: Tobe313
